title: Fertility Experiment Protocol
author: Wen Aw
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.r6yd9fw
materials: After 24 hours move flies to new vials

steps.title: Collect eggs from adults
steps.instruction: Collect eggs from adult flies of both mitotypes that have been raised on instant food.

steps.title: Collect eclosing virgin females
steps.instruction: Collect eclosing females and keep them as virgins.

steps.title: Place virgins in experimental diet vials
steps.instruction: Place the virgin females into vials containing the experimental diet, using two females per vial.

steps.title: Add one male of each mitotype
steps.instruction: Add one male of each mitotype to each vial that contains the virgin females.

steps.title: Remove all flies from vials
steps.instruction: Remove all flies from the vials.

steps.title: Determine fertility per female
steps.instruction: Determine fertility by counting the number of eclosing adult offspring per female.
